name: Remove Muddiness
description: A moderate broad cut in the low-mid region of a layered sound.

name: Remove Harshness
description: A broad upper-mid cut centered at 3500 Hz for sharp harmonics.

name: Warmth
description: A broad, gentle 3 dB low-mid boost centered at 180 Hz.

name: Presence
description: A modest upper-mid bell boost to bring harmonic detail forward.

name: Hollow Midrange
description: A broad 6 dB midrange cut to create space between low and high layers.

name: Formant Peak
description: A focused midrange boost for formant-like coloration; use headroom.

name: Spectral Sweep
description: A moderate sweeping bell when its frequency receives an LFO.
